title.en: Chapter 15 — The Law of the City

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: كان جاري تاجر، وصاحبي، وماتت مرته.
sentences.en: My neighbour was a merchant, and my friend, and his wife died.

sentences.ar: رحت أعزيه، ولقيته بيبكي زي الولد.
sentences.en: I went to console him, and found him weeping like a child.

sentences.en: He looked at me, and said: do you not know?

sentences.en: I said: what?
He said: the law.
A man whose wife dies is buried with her.

sentences.en: They washed his wife, dressed her in her best clothes, and put her in a coffin.

sentences.ar: ومشوا فيها لجبل برا المدينة، وفوقه حجر كبير.
sentences.en: And they carried her to a mountain outside the city, with a big stone on top.

sentences.en: They lifted the stone, and beneath it was a deep well, black.
They lowered the coffin into it with ropes.

sentences.en: And they put the stone back in its place.
I went home, and went to the king.
I said: my king, I am a foreigner.
This law does not apply to me.

words.caphi_raw: y i n t. i b i Q

sentences.en: The king said: you are one of us.
I said so myself.
The law is for all.
For me too.
And I went home, and looked at my wife.

words.caphi_raw: t a t. a l l u 3

sentences.ar: وصرت أدعي كل ليلة: يا رب، خليني أموت قبلها.
sentences.en: And I began praying every night: Lord, let me die before her.

sentences.ar: وهي كمان، كانت تدعي نفس الدعا.
sentences.en: And she too prayed the same prayer.
And after a year, my wife fell ill.
And she grew sicker, and sicker, and died.
And they came, washed her, dressed her, put her in the coffin.

words.caphi_raw: l a b b i s
s. u n d uu Q

sentences.ar: وربطوني، وأعطوني سبع خبزات وجرة مي.
sentences.en: And they tied me, and gave me seven loaves and a jar of water.
And I screamed, and said: I am a foreigner!
I am from Baghdad!
And no one listened.

sentences.ar: ونزلوني بالبير، والحجر رجع مكانه، والدنيا صارت سودا.
sentences.en: And they lowered me into the well, the stone went back in place, and the world went black.
